IMPACT

OPPORTUNITY

This positions your company as understanding the full attack chain from vendor compromise through customer breach.

THREAT
If physical security vendors remain unprepared for credential targeting, attackers will use compromised API keys to gain persistent, undetected access to customer facilities while evading audit logs, undermining the core trust proposition of your product. Competitors who move faster on credential protection will capture market share among security-conscious enterprises, particularly in regulated sectors like healthcare, government, and critical infrastructure.

WATCH
Monitor threat intelligence feeds and your own telemetry over the next 90 days for any evidence of automated scanning attempts against your API endpoints using spoofed or impersonated bot identities, as this will indicate whether attackers have already targeted your platform.
